description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'JEPUtil' providing static methods to evaluate mathematical expressions using the JEP (Java Expression Parser) library. It facilitates parsing and evaluating expressions with variables supplied either as a single value or a map of key-value pairs.

classes.name: JEPUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to evaluate mathematical expressions using the JEP parser.

methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression given as a string with a single variable 'x' assigned a specific double value.
